summary: Layout container that makes its child Radio Buttons mutually exclusive and outputs the selected value.
description: Radio Button Group is a flex container (like a Group) whose special duty is coordinating child Radio Buttons: exactly one can be checked, and the group's `value` output holds the `value` parameter of the selected one. `onChange` fires when the selection changes. Set `value` as an input to select programmatically.
whenToUse: Always wrap radio buttons in one — it is the single point logic should read. Nest plain Groups inside for layout; the grouping behaviour spans descendants.

ports.value: String level: the selected child's value (input to preselect, output to read).
ports.onChange: Signal; the selection changed by user action.

runtimeBehavior: Declared-port-groups: sizing/layout port variants follow the size-mode parameters, as with other visual containers.
